preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case starts with a line containing three integers n, k, l (1 ≤ n ≤ 3·10^5; 1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9; 1 ≤ l ≤ 10^9) separated by spaces.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line, n in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1:][1::2], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+1]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))]))
preconditions.description: The second line of each test case contains n integers d_1, d_2, ..., d_n (0 ≤ d_i ≤ 10^9) separated by spaces, where n is the first integer of the test case line.
Each depth d_i in the input is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ d_i ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() in ['Yes', 'No'] for stdout in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][::2]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'Yes' or 'No', indicating whether Koa can reach the island without drowning.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout == 'Yes') == any(all(d_i + p[t % (2*k)] <= l for t in range(T)) for T in range(1, 10**6) for path in possible_paths(n) if is_valid_path(path, d, k, l, p)) for stdout, d, n, k, l in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][1::2]], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+1]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+2]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+3]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))]))
postconditions.description: The output 'Yes' is correct if and only if there exists a path (sequence of waiting and swimming decisions) that allows Koa to reach the island (n+1 meters) without ever being at a position x (1 ≤ x ≤ n) at an integer time t where the depth d_x + p[t % (2*k)] exceeds l. The output 'No' is correct if no such path exists.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout == 'No') == not any(all(d_i + p[t % (2*k)] <= l for t in range(T)) for T in range(1, 10**6) for path in possible_paths(n) if is_valid_path(path, d, k, l, p)) for stdout, d, n, k, l in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][1::2]], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+1]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+2]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))], [int(stdin.split()[i*2+3]) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0]))]))
postconditions.description: The output 'No' is correct if and only if no path exists that allows Koa to reach the island without violating the depth constraint at any integer time t.
